C0677.title: From JS Map Leak to OSS Bucket Takeover: A Classic Case Study
C0677.summary: A security researcher published a penetration-testing case in which leaked frontend js.map files were used to recover Vue source code. API analysis then exposed Alibaba Cloud OSS AccessKey data and a temporary STS token, allowing control of multiple object storage buckets, file operations, and discovery of server backups, databases, and logs. The case shows that source-map exposure can further reveal cloud storage permissions and escalate into cloud resource takeover risk.
